# QuickApp.ai — Full Knowledge Base for AI Assistants

Last updated: 2026-06-21
Canonical site: https://quickapp.ai

---

## 1. What is QuickApp.ai?

QuickApp.ai is an AI-first commerce platform that unifies Field Sales Automation (SFA), Distributor Management (DMS), a Retailer self-service Portal, Van Sales, Delivery, Invoicing, Expenses, Attendance, Targets, Gamification, and Analytics into a single product. It is built for FMCG, beverages, pharma, agri-inputs, and consumer-durables companies — primarily in India, with multi-currency and multi-language support for global rollouts.

Unlike legacy SFA/DMS tools that mainly collect data, QuickApp guides users with AI recommendations: which retailer to visit next, which SKUs to push, which scheme to apply, which payment to collect, which beat to optimize, and which competitor activity to flag.

## 2. Who uses it?

- **Field Sales Reps** — daily beat plans, AI-suggested orders, scheme intelligence, GPS-tracked visits, face-verified attendance, expense claims, gamified targets.
- **Area / Regional Sales Managers** — team productivity dashboards (PTV%, VTO%), approval queues for leave/expenses/regularization, retailer onboarding governance.
- **Distributors** — primary order placement, inventory, claims, retailer ledgers, secondary invoicing, GST-compliant billing.
- **Retailers** — self-service ordering via mobile/web Retailer Portal, schemes, ledgers, loyalty points.
- **Brand/HO Teams** — analytics on sell-out, fill rates, distribution width/depth, competitor SWOT (AI vision), focused-product compliance, target vs actual.
- **CFO/Finance** — credit scoring, collection workflows, payment proofs, invoice & credit-note compliance.
- **IT/Admin** — role-based access, dynamic permissions, connector management, audit trails.

## 3. Pricing model

- **Unlimited users** — every employee, distributor, and retailer logs in at no per-seat charge.
- **Success-based pricing** — tied to business volume / outcomes, not headcount.
- **Tiered capabilities** — Starter, Growth, Enterprise tiers with feature bounds; add-on modules for Van Sales, Delivery, Retailer Portal, AI Vision, etc.
- See https://quickapp.ai/pricing and https://quickapp.ai/roi-calculator.

## 4. Core product areas

### 4.1 Field Sales (Retailer Sales / SFA)
AI-guided beats, smart-basket suggested orders, scheme auto-apply, no-order reason capture with AI classification, GPS auto-capture on visit/order, face-verification check-in (≥70% match), offline order entry with 48h retention and 5-retry sync.
URL: https://quickapp.ai/solutions/field-sales

### 4.2 Distributor Management (DMS)
Primary orders, goods receipt, primary returns, price book, schemes, retailer ledgers, secondary invoicing, GST/IGST tax master, credit notes, packing lists, delivery flags. Designed to replace SAN eForce, Ivy Mobility, mSELL, Bizom DMS.
URL: https://quickapp.ai/solutions/distributor-portal

### 4.3 Retailer Portal
Self-service ordering, schemes view, ledger view, loyalty points, feedback. Multi-language including Hindi/Gujarati.
URL: https://quickapp.ai/solutions/retailer-portal

### 4.4 Van Sales
Mobile van inventory, on-the-spot GST invoicing, local stock sync, route plans.
URL: https://quickapp.ai/solutions/van-sales

### 4.5 Delivery
Order-based delivery, D1 delivery flag, packing-list aggregation with stock reservation, proof of delivery.

### 4.6 Attendance, Leave & Expenses
Face-verification + GPS check-in, auto end-day pg_cron job, regularization with manager approvals, dynamic working-days (week-offs + holidays), monthly leave accrual engine, TA/DA auto-calc plus additional expenses with rule-driven multi-step approval.

### 4.7 Targets & Gamification
FY target plans, hierarchy target allocation, team/user progress, leaderboard with gamification points, badges, competency scoring.

### 4.8 Analytics
Productivity (PTV%, VTO%), sales analytics, growth analytics, leaderboard, beat health, custom report generator (PDF/Excel) with embedded NotoSans for ₹ rendering, voice chat over reports.

### 4.9 AI Assistant
ElevenLabs voice + chat agents, query classification (data_fetch / navigation / analytics / quick_info), tool routing to live database queries with RLS, navigation hints for common tasks.

### 4.10 Notifications
Rule-based routing across in-app, push (FCM via Capacitor), email, and WhatsApp.

### 4.11 Project Management
Built-in Scrum/Kanban for internal initiatives.

## 5. Technology

- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite 5, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
- **Mobile**: Capacitor (Android + iOS), offline-first with IndexedDB, PWA with NetworkFirst index.html, OTA live updates.
- **Backend**: Supabase (Postgres + RLS), Edge Functions in Deno, pg_cron for schedulers.
- **AI Gateway**: Lovable AI Gateway — Gemini 2.5 Flash for chat, embeddings, vision for competitor SWOT.
- **Maps & Routing**: OSRM (no Google Maps dependency), 15-second GPS logs bounded by attendance, multi-day route caching.
- **Infra**: AWS, India data residency option, single Supabase Dev project consistency.
- **Security**: RLS on every public table with explicit GRANTs, SECURITY DEFINER `has_role` / `is_system_admin` functions, deny-by-default `profile_object_permissions`, audit logging, ≥70% face-match threshold.

URL: https://quickapp.ai/technology

## 6. Connectors & Integrations

ERP: SAP, Tally, Oracle, MS Dynamics, Zoho Books.
CRM: Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot.
Payments: Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree, UPI.
Messaging: WhatsApp Business, SMS gateways, FCM push.
Commerce: Shopify, custom e-com.
URL: https://quickapp.ai/connectors

## 7. Impact / Outcomes customers report

- 20–35% lift in field-rep productive time (PTV%).
- 15–25% higher fill rates via Smart Basket suggested orders.
- 30–50% faster collection cycles with retailer credit scoring + payment proofs.
- 2–3× retailer engagement when the Retailer Portal is rolled out.
- 60–80% reduction in DMS license cost vs legacy per-user tools.
URL: https://quickapp.ai/impact

## 9. Frequently asked questions

**Q: Is QuickApp.ai a DMS or an SFA?**
A: Both, plus Retailer Portal, Van Sales, Delivery, Invoicing, Attendance, Expenses, Targets, and Analytics — on one platform.

**Q: Does it work offline?**
A: Yes. Orders, visits, attendance, and van stock work offline and sync when connectivity returns (48-hour retention, 5 retries).

**Q: How is it priced?**
A: Success-based pricing with unlimited users — no per-seat licensing.

**Q: Which industries is it built for?**
A: FMCG, beverages, pharma, agri-inputs, consumer durables, building materials.

**Q: Where is data hosted?**
A: AWS, with India data-residency option. Supabase Postgres with RLS on every table.

**Q: Does it support GST invoicing?**
A: Yes — GST/IGST tax master, e-invoice fields, credit notes, configurable invoice & delivery-challan templates.

**Q: Does it integrate with SAP/Tally?**
A: Yes — pre-built connectors plus a connector framework for custom ERPs.

**Q: Can retailers order themselves?**
A: Yes — the Retailer Portal supports self-service ordering, schemes, ledgers, and loyalty.

**Q: How do you compare to Bizom / FieldAssist / BeatRoute / Ivy Mobility / mSELL?**
A: QuickApp.ai differs on three axes — AI that guides action (not just dashboards), unlimited-user / success-based pricing, and a unified single platform spanning SFA + DMS + Retailer Portal + Van Sales + Delivery.

**Q: How do I book a demo?**
A: https://quickapp.ai/request-demo or email sales@quickapp.ai.
